status: complete - beats 1-8 played across 4 driver runs, screenshots read

defects.where: verdant-3, cp-northbank [0, 2.60, 20.4] - the checkpoint the course puts you on after the log crossing - facing the north bank, the REQUIRED route to the wheat terraces and everything after them.
defects.did: Stood on the checkpoint and held W north along the cart track (the one the trail coins at [0,19],[0,13],[0,6],[0,2] mark) for 12 s, then another 8 s. Then four more attempts: run-and-jump up it (slope.recoverJumpV 10.5); and hold W north from z=21 at x = -16, -8, +8 and +16; and finally walk DOWN from the wheat field and back up.
defects.happened: The hero got 1.3 m off the jetty to z=19.1, dropped into state slopeSlide and stayed there. 20 'slide' events on the first attempt, 48 on the second; final position [-0.25, 2.60, 19.22] after 20 s of held forward. He never passed z=19.2. The screenshot shows why: the north bank is a near-vertical wall of dark brown dirt filling the whole frame, with the cart-track coins hanging in front of it and the lowest one buried inside it. MEASURED OFF THE LIVE HEIGHTFIELD (Broadphase.heightfields[].heightAt(0, z), 0.5 m steps): the required cart track at x=0 climbs z 22.0 -> 16.5 at 40.7-48.7 DEGREES for eleven consecutive bands (worst 48.7 deg at z 21.5 -> 20.0, y -0.02 -> 1.69), with two more 40.0 deg bands at z 11.0 -> 10.0. The wheat field only goes flat at z = 7.5 (y 10.20). TUNE.slope.slideDeg is 38, so the whole climb is 3 to 11 degrees over the slide threshold. EVERY line failed the same way. Held W: the hero oscillates run / slopeSlide / pivot between z 18.8 and 19.5 for 8 s and finishes at z 19.17 (29 'slide' events). Jumping up it: the slope-recovery jumps fling him sideways and he ends IN THE RIVER at [-12.27, -0.27, 33.86], swimming. x = -16 / -8 / +8 / +16 all ended swimming as well ([0.62,-1.06,23.43], [14.16,-2.59,26.5], [29.66,-0.04,22.19], [39.68,0.06,22.57]) - four for four, across a 32 m width. The face IS walkable higher up: from [9.97, 6.14, 15.24] a held W climbed back to the wheat field at y 10.05 with one slide event. So it is only the bottom 5.5 m out of the jetty that is impassable - and that is exactly where the checkpoint puts you.
defects.should: The course header states 'the bank -> the terraces 24.8 deg' and 'TUNE.slope.slideDeg is 38, so nothing required slides'. The heightfield the game builds says 40.7-48.7 deg. A player who reaches checkpoint 2 cannot advance past it and cannot go back - the crossing behind him is water. Beats 3 through 8 of the course are unreachable in normal play; everything else in this report was reached by teleport.

defects.where: verdant-3, inside the granary cellar after pounding the breakable mezzanine (breakable at [-8, 17.20, -16]; cellar floor GRANARY_Y 13.60). Player ends at [-7.98, 15.08, -15.98].
defects.did: Stood on the mezzanine at [-8, 18.2, -16], jumped, held C to ground-pound through the floor, collected the secret crest, then held W toward the south door. RE-VERIFY RUN: repeated the same sequence on a fresh boot.
defects.happened: The pound worked and the SECRET CREST collected (crests 0 -> 1). Then the hero froze: position [-7.98, 15.08, -15.98] identical across every sample, state 'fall', grounded false, speed 0, vy running away to -14.76 m/s. Holding W for 14 s moved him 0.00 m. defects.should: After breaking the floor you should land on the cellar floor at 13.60 and be able to walk out through the south door. As it stands the secret-crest route ends with the player stuck in the world and needing T (to checkpoint) or a death to escape.

defects.where: verdant-3, the granary terrace at [1.95, 13.93, -21.66] and generally wherever terrain is in shadow
defects.did: Stood on the terrace in the granary's shadow.
defects.happened: Shadowed grass goes to near-black - most of the terrace, and the rising ground east of it, is an unreadable dark mass. In the same frame the sigils pedestal's gold beam renders as a hard-edged tapering SPIKE about 10 m long stabbing down out of the sky and through the ground, and the pedestal bowl reads as a flat gold canoe lying in the grass.
defects.should: CONTRACT §15 READABILITY LAW: the walked surface must hold contrast. A shadow that takes grass to near-black hides the ground you are about to run on, and the crest pedestal beam should read as a column of light, not a solid blade.

defects.did: Walked the upper wheat terrace and looked around.
defects.happened: Large brown timber slabs (3.6 x 8.0 m) hang unsupported in the air over the terraces with nothing under them - no piers, no trestles. Three are visible from one standing position.
defects.should: Six floating timber decks over farmland is the biggest single contributor to this course looking over-dressed (owner's flag for this course). Either put legs under them or sit them on the ground the millrace already follows.

defects.where: verdant-3, THE CHAFF CANNON at [14, 23.10, -40] (ROUTE C to the sky platform), approached from [14, 24.0, -37]
defects.did: Stood 3 m south of the cannon and held W into it for 9 s, then pressed E (interact), then pressed Space.
defects.happened: The hero did not move at all - position [14, 24, -37] unchanged for the whole 9 s of held W (the walk was marked STUCK at d=3.00). E produced no event whatsoever - no cannonEnter, empty event list. Space just made him jump and land 1.7 m lower at [14.53, 22.30, -36.75].
defects.should: The sign two metres away says THE CHAFF CANNON / CLIMB IN, and launch.js is meant to solve the launch onto the sky platform. Route C does not exist in play: you cannot walk to the cannon and you cannot enter it.

defects.where: verdant-3, the ridge path walking west from cp-ridge [-4, 19.20, -30] toward mill 3's jump pad [-30, 20.14, -44], past rotor gate 2 at [-24.5, 22.30, -37.6]
defects.did: Held W west along the ridge path.
defects.happened: death:void at [-27.8, -20.1, -40]. The hero fell out of the world (killY is -20) on that walk and respawned at cp-ridge. Ground at (-27.8, -40) should be about 22 m by the course's own heightfield recipe.
defects.should: The ridge path is the spine of beat 6 - the rotor gates, mills 2 and 3, the wing nest. Walking it west drops you through the world.

defects.where: verdant-3, the BELL STAIR: five vanish flagstones at x 9.4 / 14.8 / 20.2 / 25.6 / 31.0, y 21.30 to 27.70, z -30 (cycle on 20 / off 12 / warn 2.5, phase 0), read at course clock 17-19 s, inside the on-window
defects.did: Pounded at the bell, then ran east for flagstone 1 and jumped at each stone in turn.
defects.happened: Two things. (a) Every flagstone reported its collider ACTIVE (solid true) while its mesh was NOT visible - all five, inside the on-window - and nothing was visible in the frame where the stair should be. (b) The ground east of the bell is a slide face: the hero went to slopeSlide at [8.92, 18.04, -29.36], slid to [10.66, 16.38, -28.48], wall-slid, and finished at [14.02, 13.02, -22.63] in the sack gully 8 m below the stair. Flagstone 1's top is 21.60 against a bell path at 19.2-19.3, so the first step is +2.3 m - over the single jump's 1.91 m apex - and you slide off before you reach it.
defects.should: The sign says POUND THE BELL / THE STAIR ANSWERS FOR TWENTY SECONDS. Nothing answers, and the ground you would run along is a slide. The BELL STAIR race crest is unreachable.

defects.where: verdant-3, THE BELL (kind breakable, p [4.0, 20.60, -30.0], s [1.7, 2.0, 1.7], mat metal, tint 0xc9a24a) and the pendulum sacks (mode ball, mat cloth, tint WHEAT)
defects.did: Walked up to the bell and looked at it and at the sacks over the ridge.
defects.happened: The bell renders as a plain grey steel crate with a yellow X painted on it - a generic breakable box, not a bell - and the brass tint is not applied. The nearby grain sacks render as black spiked balls on chains hanging from rusty brackets; they read as wrecking balls or naval mines.
defects.should: A sign that says POUND THE BELL needs a bell. Wheat-tinted cloth sacks should not be black spiked spheres. Same cloth-tint failure as V3-20.

defects.where: verdant-3, ROUTE A THE SCAFFOLD, ledge 1 [17, 24.60, -44.2] to ledge 2 [17, 26.00, -39.4] - 1.8 m of air at +1.40, and the route the reach gate walks
defects.did: Stood on ledge 1 (3.4 x 3.0 m) and did a run-and-jump at ledge 2: 330 ms of run, then a 250 ms held Space.
defects.happened: He landed 0.4 m short of ledge 2's south lip, at [18.21, 23.82, -41.29], on the yard grass 2.2 m below. MISS. The ledge is only 3.0 m deep, so there is no run-up on it to take.
defects.should: The scaffold is the STATIC route to the open crest and the reason that crest is not gated on mill timing. Its first step needs a run-up its own ledge cannot give.

defects.where: verdant-3, rotor gate 1 at [-11, 20.35, -32.6] (style bar, 3 arms, period 7, no kill)
defects.did: Walked into the gate's sweep and then stood perfectly still for 8 s.
defects.happened: The bar shoved the stationary hero 2.4 m sideways and 1.4 m uphill (from [-9.88, 19.39, -32.78] to [-11.56, 20.77, -34.31]) and then wedged him there - position unchanged for the last 13 samples. No death, no damage.
defects.should: A rideable bar you time is fine; ending pinned against the terrain after standing still is not.

worked: Entering verdant-3 with __dev.goto works and boots into cp-riverbank; the HUD is storybook glass, not a debug overlay - coins x/100, eight sigil pips, CHECKPOINT n/4.
Every checkpoint I reached fired on walk-through and updated the HUD: cp-riverbank (0), cp-northbank (1), cp-granary (2).
Q / E camera orbit works on the yaw axis (camYaw 0 -> 2.453 -> -2.97) and Z recentres exactly onto the hero's facing.
Held W runs at the authored speed: max 9.12 m/s measured on open grass against TUNE.speedRun 9.0.
Signage is genuinely good: the two quay signs, the WINDMILL HEIGHTS board and the hay-belt sign are all crisp, correctly wrapped and readable from where a player stands.
Coins collect on contact and the counter rolls up; the underwater ring paid 11 coins.
SIGIL 3 on the upper hay deck collects on contact ([12, 13.65, -4], reached from the north field rather than up the belt).
The GROUND POUND breaks the granary mezzanine and the SECRET CREST spawns and collects - crests 0 -> 1. That whole puzzle works right up to the point where the player gets stuck (V3-02).

The GNASHER has a real bounded disc: 6 s standing still at 6.6 m from its post produced no attack, and it does kill inside the 5.5 m chain. Its silhouette (black body, white teeth) reads clearly at 20 m.
The BUMBLER never hurt a stationary player - 6 s standing beside one, 0 deaths, kills:0 as CONTRACT §23 requires.
The hay belts read well: dark ribbed treads with big green direction chevrons, unmistakable at a glance.
Falling in the river never kills or drowns you - 0 deaths across every water test. Respawn measured 141-650 ms.
The meadow, the paddock fence, the checkpoint pads, the crest pedestals with their gold beams and the hero model itself all look good.

ALL FOUR MILLS TURN and mill 1's gondola genuinely CARRIES the player: grounded and idle from y 15.85 to 22.96 over 7.2 s, then released past the top of the sweep. Mill colliders moved 3.2-6.1 m in 0.89 s of course clock on every mill.
The north bank IS walkable above z~15 - from [9.97, 6.14, 15.24] a held W climbed back to the wheat field at y 10.05. Only the bottom 5.5 m out of the jetty (z 22 -> 16.5) is over the slide angle.

THE OPEN CREST WORKS END TO END: walking from [41, 35.90, -48] to [46.82, 35.90, -48.02] on the sky platform collected CREST ABOVE THE SAILS (crests 0 -> 1) plus a coin, and the game moved to state 'clear' - the course-clear card fired.
All five checkpoints fired on walk-through and the HUD tracked them: cp-riverbank(0), cp-northbank(1), cp-granary(2), cp-ridge(3), cp-yard(4).
SIGIL 7 up at mill 3 collects (sigils 0 -> 1 on the balcony), as does SIGIL 3 on the upper hay deck.
The pendulum sacks are fair: 5.6 s standing directly under sack 1 at the ridge-stair foot, no hit, no death - there they pass 1.3 m over a standing player's head.
Respawn is fast and clean everywhere it fired: 141 / 158 / 388 / 599 / 650 ms measured against the 700 ms median target.

Draw calls and triangles are inside budget at every station I stood at: mill yard 165 draws / 284,972 tris, sky platform 91 / 141,870, ridge path 209 / 375,954, granary terrace 155 / 295,502, spawn 96 / 168,842. The worst single frame seen was the very first spawn frame at 227 / 440,704. Budget is 260 draws / 450k tris.
blocked: THE COURSE AS A COURSE. V3-01 (the north bank) makes everything past checkpoint 2 unreachable on foot, so every beat from 3 to 8 in this report was entered with __dev.tp. I never played verdant-3 as one continuous run and neither can a player.

ROUTE B, THE GREAT MILL SAIL RIDE. I could not board it: dropping onto the lowest gondola's reported position landed me on the yard at [31.1, 23.6, -48] instead, because the mill (period 9.0, the fastest on the course) had turned between the probe read and the teleport. I did NOT test the honest route - stand on the boarding plinth at [22, 24.80, -48] and wait for a gondola - so I cannot say whether route B works. Mill 1's identical gondola DID carry me cleanly, so the mechanism itself is sound.

THE MILLRACE crest (race, 65 s, start [0, 10.20, 2.0] to finish [23, 23.60, -56.5]) and THE BELL STAIR crest (race, 20 s): never started. The millrace start pad is past the impassable north bank; the bell stair is V3-33.
THE WING POWER and the TEN RINGS: I reached mill 3's balcony but overshot the nest at [-34, 26.60, -44] and never had the hat, so the ring run and the POWER crest are untested.

SIGILS 2, 4, 5, 6 and 8, and the HUNDRED COINS crest: sigil 2 is on a downstream log across the current (V3-03 wedge), 4 is on the granary roof (V3-04 slide-lock), 5 is on gully crag 2 (V3-28 overshoot), 6 is on mill 2's gallery and 8 on the great mill's gallery (V3-35 scaffold miss, plus a bonk at [27.73, 30.2, -44.9]). I finished the whole playtest on 12 coins of the 100 needed.

FRAME RATE. Every figure I saw was 20-28 fps headless, but the box had about 88 of the owner's own Chrome processes running throughout (HARNESS_NOTES: a perf run is only evidence if the GPU engine was idle). Treat the fps numbers here as not-evidence; the draw and triangle counts are fine to use.
